career_ladder.note: Military Engineer Services (MES) under the Ministry of Defence recruits civilian technical and inventory supervisors. Supervisor Barrack & Store (SBS) enters as a Group 'B' Non-Gazetted officer in 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6 and progresses into the Barrack & Store Gazetted Cadre up to Director level.

exam_scheme.note: The examination scheme for Supervisor Barrack & Store in Military Engineer Services consists of an OMR-based Written Examination followed by Document Verification. The written exam comprises 100 questions carrying 125 marks (or 100 questions of 1 mark each as notified) of 120 minutes duration across four sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning (25), Numerical Aptitude (25), General English & General Awareness (25), and Specialized Topic / Material Management (25 or 50 marks). Negative marking of 0.25 marks is deducted for each incorrect response.

financial_package.note: Supervisor Barrack & Store in Military Engineer Services is placed in 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6 (entry basic ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400). As civilian defence employees, staff receive central Dearness Allowance, HRA, Transport Allowance, and defence establishment amenities.
financial_package.pay_source_label: MES Advt. — Pay Scale for Supervisor (Barrack & Store)
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹35,400 + 58% DA (₹20,532) + HRA (10%-30% by location: ₹3,540 to ₹10,620) + Transport Allowance (₹2,844 to ₹5,688) yields gross ~₹62,000 to ~₹76,000. In-hand reflects ~10% NPS deduction and standard deductions.
official_perks: Government-funded residential quarters in military cantonments / MES stations or full central HRA
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) or Military Hospital outpatient access for civilian employees
CSD Canteen smart card amenities across military stations
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% monthly government matching contribution
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
